C1788.title: Tax Agency Forges R&D Personnel Identities to Fraudulently Obtain High-Tech Enterprise Status
C1788.summary: Xu Chi, the actual controller of Shenyang-based tax agency Yuzhi Technology, assisted client enterprises in fraudulently applying for high-tech enterprise qualifications by issuing false invoices and fabricating R&D activities. The scheme involved misrepresenting passenger transport drivers as 'researchers' and creating fake R&D projects to illicitly secure tax incentives and government subsidies,
